notes.title: Final Release is just around the corner!
notes.notes:
Yes, it is finally happening - and it will be epic! The critically acclaimed vocal 2D platformer where you solve puzzles, by singing or humming into your microphone gets a final release date. And it will be released on all platforms - even mobiles! - at the same time! How many games are there that do that?

ONE HAND CLAPPING will be released on December 14th, 2021!

So give yourself an early Xmas treat and get your very own copy of One Hand Clapping on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33811580/9d7657ace453a820178d68abf32b020065bfb657.png

Awards, Awards, Awards and Prizes!
This beautiful game is already loved by critics & influencers and was awarded many prestigious prizes. E.g. the Indiecade Audience Choice Award, Intentional Play Summit Best Student Game, USC Game City Bazillion Dollar Idea and lately a "Pädagogischer Medienpreis" as well as the Creative Gaming Award for "Most Creative Game". 

One Hand Clapping, being uplifting and accessible for everyone, sets out to make you a believer in your own musical skills. 
Interact with a colorful world and solve puzzles with melody, rhythm, and harmony. How you do it is completely up to you: no matter if you prefer singing, whistling, jamming, or even using a crazy instrument, One Hand Clapping will be your unique musical journey where ever you go!

notes.title: Update notes for 0.12.48
notes.notes:
Hi, friends!

We’re happy to release the second half of Fugue Forest as part of version 0.12.48, the last early access content update before the game’s full release. The following is what the update is focused on:

· Descend into the dark second half of Fugue Forest 
· Improved art in many of the previous areas 
· Improved audio analysis 
· Added voice visualizer to help find any microphone related issues

For more details and a personal word from the developers themselves visit: https://www.baddreamgames.com/devlog/early-access-second-update

Thanks for singing your song!

Sing your song!

notes.title: Version 0.12.21
notes.notes:
Reworked resonant rock section (the one with the flying bell)
 Rebalanced wind currents section
 Rebalanced sandstorm section
 Tweaked voice recording mechanics on flowers in the beginning of Fugue Forest
 Improved audio analysis
 Polished art in several places
 Added jump buffering
 Fixed snapping to one-way platforms
 Fixed issues with getting stuck in tight spaces
 Fixed Duet Desert hug drop-off bug where you would fall through the ground
 Fixed animation walk loop issues
 Implemented a possible fix to prevent a rare crash in Duet Desert


Please note that this update will not be able to load your previous save file. You can still select all previously unlocked checkpoints directly in the checkpoints menu to get very close to where you stopped last time. If you didn’t know, you can press left and right in the checkpoint menu to cycle through checkpoints inside the different biomes.
